classification: posthoc engineering description, frozen before this aggregation, not preregistered new scientific evidence
groups: every seed and pooled seeds; each existing budget and intervention; all five policies
quality: correct/all roots, coverage, wrong/answered; unresolved roots count as failures
actual_work: sum of executed retrieve+verify+backtrack/restart calls, candidate evaluations, dense inference FLOPs estimate
cpu: sum measured per-trajectory CPU, not total training or setup cost; one measurement, no stability/ranking inference
frontier: descriptive nondominance within same seed scope, budget/depth, and intervention, maximizing accuracy and minimizing actual calls and measured CPU; never compare different depths as the same task
comparability: Only bounded vs fixed_relation shares the scorer and risk rule; other policies confound head/controller/information. No equal-work superiority ranking, no useless padding, no selected matched-success subset.
failures: v1 totals remain unknown; retain its measured lower bounds and all failed trajectories; v2-only frontier excludes duplicate v1 evaluations but cumulative ledger keeps both
acceptance: Reject scientific ranking: no fixed equal actual workload, CPU replication, natural data, pretrained Encoder, or 8-16 semantic depth. Output every observed point, not only frontier points.
